overall_goal: Clean up the kitchen, wash hands, and put away ingredients and utensils

goals.description: Put the yogurt in the refrigerator
goals.rationale: The person picks up the yogurt container, opens the refrigerator, places it inside, and closes the door.

goals.description: Get a plate from the cabinet
goals.rationale: The person opens the upper cabinet, retrieves a plate, and closes the cabinet doors.
The person turns on the tap, washes hands with soap and water, shakes off excess water, and dries them with a kitchen rag.

goals.description: Get a tablespoon from the cutlery drawer
goals.rationale: The person opens the lower cabinet and drawer, takes out a tablespoon, and closes the drawer and cabinet.

goals.description: Stack used bowls near the sink
goals.rationale: The person gathers multiple empty bowls, stacks them together, and places the stack on a plate next to the kitchen sink.
The person washes their hands under the tap, shakes off the water, and dries them using a kitchen rag.

goals.description: Throw fallen food bits into the rubbish bin
goals.rationale: The person picks up bits of food that fell on the countertop and throws them into the rubbish bin.

goals.description: Put the sauce bowl in the refrigerator
goals.rationale: The person picks up the bowl of prepared sauce, opens the refrigerator, places it inside, and closes the door.

goals.description: Gather used bowls and cutlery in the sink
goals.rationale: The person stacks smaller bowls into a large bowl and places used cutlery into the kitchen sink to be washed later.
The person rinses their hands under the tap, shakes off the water, and dries them with the kitchen rag.

goals.description: Put away condiment jars and olive oil
goals.rationale: The person gathers multiple condiment jars and a bottle of olive oil from the countertop and places them neatly into the bottom cabinet.

goals.description: Put away the bag of tortillas
goals.rationale: The person picks up the bag of tortillas, shakes it to gather them together, and places the bag on the cooling rack.
The person picks up the plastic measuring cup, opens the utensil drawer, places the cup inside, and closes the drawer.
